is_prime() {
  local n=$1
  if [ $n -le 1 ]; then return 1; fi
  for ((i=2; i*i<=n; i++))
    do
      if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then return 1; fi
  done
  return 0
}

for num in 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 10
  do
    if is_prime $num; then
      echo "$num is prime"
    fi
done

process_files() {
  local dir=$1
  local count=0
  for file in "$dir"/*
    do
      if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        count=$((count + 1))
      elif [ -d "$file" ]; then
        process_files "$file"
      fi
  done
  echo "$dir: $count files"
}
